description: Video Guide Skill — OpenAI-compatible function-calling definitions. Paste the 'tools' array into your system/assistant config.

function.name: validate_recipe
function.description: Validate a Video Guide recipe JSON without rendering. Performs TTS synthesis and timing checks. Returns warnings, overlap alerts, and the full plan text. ALWAYS call this before render_guide to catch audio-overlap issues early.

recipe_json.description: The complete recipe JSON as a string. Must follow the Video Guide recipe schema (see schemas/recipe.schema.json).

function.name: render_guide
function.description: Render a complete user-guide MP4 video from a recipe JSON. Produces narration (Edge TTS), animated HUD dock overlays, click/zoom annotations, background music, and an SRT caption file. Requires screen-recording frames on disk at paths referenced in the recipe.

recipe_json.description: The complete recipe JSON as a string.

output_path.description: Absolute file path for the output .mp4. E.g. C:/Users/me/guides/my_guide.mp4

export_srt.description: If true (default), also write a .srt caption file next to the mp4.

function.name: extract_frames
function.description: Extract still frames from a screen recording video at a chosen FPS (default 3). Writes 0001_frame.png, 0002_frame.png … into output_dir. The returned frames_dir and frame filenames are used in recipe timeline_mapping steps.

video_path.description: Absolute path to the screen recording file (.mp4, .mov, .mkv, .avi).

fps.description: Frames per second to extract. 3 fps is recommended for UI walkthroughs (one frame every ~0.33 s).

output_dir.description: Directory to write extracted frame PNGs into. Defaults to <video_dir>/<video_stem>_frames/ if omitted.

executor.description: To execute a tool call, run tool_executor.py with the tool name and arguments.

examples.python: from tool_executor import extract_frames; result = extract_frames(video_path='C:/rec.mp4', fps=3)
